details: CONFIRMED, reproduced (by accident): I ran `python3 -m unittest tests.test_eval_system_rules` at 15:49; at 15:51

is broken for every session and lane until restored. On master the scaffold test looped over only the four non-stub cases, so

too), so every gate run on any branch after this merges clobbers the live command again. Breaks the project rule
"Tests use a temporary folder and never touch the live ..." (CLAUDE.local.md, Python) and the Secrets/Shell-independent
promise that tests do not touch the owner's home. I could not restore it: the main-checkout guard refuses `git checkout --
bin/relay` there; the front must restore it (git -C /Users/amidman/relay checkout -- bin/relay). Size 10 minutes.
